column1: # Size-literal ledger (HC-0). Read by Tests/EditMode/SizeLiteralGuardTests.cs; the scanner is SizeLiteralScanner.cs.
# Columns: file (under Assets/WarCore) <TAB> token <TAB> count <TAB> tag <TAB> note.
# Tags: canon = the one place a value is defined; ui = drawn-only feel; math = not a size (unit vector, cell centre,
# unit conversion); debt = an old copy or a value that belongs in the content pack. canon, ui and math need a note.
# debt-max must equal the total count of debt rows. It may only go down: remove a copy, lower the row and debt-max.
# A new literal is read from the content pack or from the one named source; it is not added here as debt.
# Debt notes name the family in the audit: H1 body radius, H2 headroom, H3 speed, H4 grenade, M1 eye, M2 play distances,
